description: Eight candidate Delhi underpass/low-lying locations. Coordinates and rainfall thresholds are INITIAL ESTIMATES for demonstration only and have NOT been independently verified against engineering or municipal sources. Set verified=false for every spot. Thresholds are in mm of hourly precipitation and represent a proxy for potential waterlogging, not a confirmed flood prediction.
source: Demonstration inputs; not official engineering measurements
